name: Balto
tagline: Balto provides real-time AI guidance to call centre agents during live calls, prompting them with the best next response, compliance alerts, and objection-handling scripts. Unlike post-call analytics tools, Balto intervenes in the moment to improve outcomes, reducing average handle time and increasing conversion rates.
